blocks.text: Pani mein hal shuda acids aur bases poori tarah dissociate ho bhi sakte hain aur nahi bhi. Bohat se acids kamzor electrolytes hain aur 100 feesad se bohat kam ionise hote hain. Ka ki qeemat, acid ka dissociation constant, acid ki taqat ka miqdari paimana (quantitative measure) hai. Pani mein acid HA ke liye HA + H2O se H3O+ + A-, aur Kc = [H3O+][A-] / ([HA][H2O]); pani ki mustaqil concentration ko doosri taraf le ja kar Kc [H2O] = [H3O+][A-] / [HA], aur Kc [H2O] = Ka ke saath: Ka = [H3O+][A-] / [HA]. Yeh muadla kisi bhi tezabi solution ka Ka deta hai jab pH ya [H+] aur hal shuda acid ki ibtidai concentration maloom ho, aur yeh H3O+ aur A- ki equilibrium concentrations bhi deta hai jab HA ki ibtidai concentration aur us ka Ka maloom ho.

blocks.title: Ka se acid ki taqat
blocks.text: Jab Ka 10^-3 se kam ho to acid kamzor (weak) hai; jab Ka 1 aur 10^-3 ke darmiyan ho to acid darmiyana taqatwar (moderately strong); jab Ka 1 se zyada ho to acid taqatwar (strong).

blocks.caption: Kuch acids ki Ka qeematein (Table 9.3, sahi qeematon ke saath)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Table 9.3 mein kai ghaltiyan chhapi hain: (1) HCl, HNO3 aur H2SO4 ko 'bohat bara' kehne ke baad brackets mein 10^-2, 10^-5 aur 10^-2 likha hai. Strong acid ka Ka 1 se bohat zyada hota hai, is liye yeh qeematein ghalat hain; maqbool andazan qeematein HCl taqreeban 10^6 se 10^7, HNO3 taqreeban 20 se 25, aur H2SO4 (pehla qadam) taqreeban 10^3 hain. (2) HSO4- ka Ka 1.3 x 10^-4 chhapa hai; sahi taqreeban 1.2 x 10^-2 hai (darmiyana taqatwar acid). (3) HF ka 6.7 x 10^-5 chhapa hai; sahi taqreeban 6.8 x 10^-4 hai. (4) HCO3- ka 4.7 x 10^-12 chhapa hai; sahi 4.7 x 10^-11 hai, aur CO3 2- ka minus chhoot gaya hai. (5) H2CO3 ka dissociation 'H+ + HS-' chhapa hai; sahi H+ + HCO3- hai. (6) Ammonium ko 'NH4 1' aur product 'NH5' likha hai; sahi NH4+ se H+ + NH3 hai. (7) Pani ka Ka 1.8 x 10^-15 likha hai; kitab khud topic 9.3 mein 1.8 x 10^-16 deti hai (Kw / 55.5), wahi sahi hai. Yeh andazan qeematein standard tables se hain.

blocks.prompt: Sirke ka namoona 0.837 M CH3COOH hai aur us ki hydronium concentration 3.86 x 10^-3 mol dm-3. Ka nikalein (Quick Check 9.3c).

items: Ka = Kc [H2O] = [H3O+][A-] / [HA] acid ki taqat napta hai: Ka 10^-3 se kam weak, 1 se 10^-3 moderately strong, 1 se zyada strong.

Table 9.3: HCl, HNO3 aur H2SO4 bohat bare (Ka 1 se kahin zyada); HSO4- taqreeban 1.2 x 10^-2; HF taqreeban 6.8 x 10^-4, CH3COOH 1.85 x 10^-5, H2S 1.0 x 10^-7, NH4+ 5.7 x 10^-10, HCO3- 4.7 x 10^-11, H2O bohat weak.
